instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page high-converting agency site for MZ Tech
Highlight 17 years of software development & digital marketing expertise
Include interactive service cards for Web Dev, SEO, Digital Marketing, and Marketing Automation
Build tailored audience tabs/toggle for Builders/Temporary Fencing vs Mortgage Brokers
Include an interactive ROI / Lead Estimator widget allowing builders and brokers to estimate monthly lead growth
Use Sonner for toast notifications when user submits the enquiry form or calculates ROI
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and form submissions
Ensure glassmorphism nav with clear contact button and zero transparent content overlaps
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Exclude transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles with hover interaction animations & brand accent color.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Lucide or Phosphor icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
